sentences.en: The dictator had the absolute loyalty of all his aides.
sentences.zh: 那个独裁者得到了所有助手的绝对忠诚。

sentences.en: It's an absolute waste of time to wait any longer.
sentences.zh: 再等下去纯粹是浪费时间。

sentences.en: "How is her condition?" "She must have absolute bed rest."
sentences.zh: “她的病情怎么样？”“她必须绝对卧床休息。”
